% Shared normative core: equations
\section{Reference estimator, response, and uncertainty}
\label{sec:equations}

\subsection{Authoritative coordinate-basis operator}

For every admitted anchor $p\in\Valid$,
\begin{align}
 m_p &= E_pm, & t_p &= E_pt_p^{\rm full}, \\
 n_p &= t_p^{\mathsf T}W_pm_p, &
 d_p &= t_p^{\mathsf T}W_pt_p, \\
 \widehat a_p &= \frac{n_p}{d_p}, &
 L_{p,g}u &= \frac{t_p^{\mathsf T}W_pE_pu}{d_p}, \\
 R_{\rm fixed}(p,s) &= L_{p,g}t_s^{\rm full}. &&
\end{align}
$W_p=W_p^{\dagger}$ and $u^{\dagger}W_pu\geq0$. The scientific
normalization $d_p$ is finite, exactly real, and strictly positive. Failure of
one of these exact predicates is typed unavailability or attempt failure,
never amplitude zero. Ordinary floating-point evidence for the exact
identities belongs to the preregistered numerical-conformance profile.

\subsection{Matching-template and general-sky relations}

For the matching single-template model
\[
 m=A t_s^{\rm full}+n,
 \qquad \operatorname E[n\mid g]=0,
\]
linearity gives
\[
 \operatorname E[\widehat a_p\mid g]=A R_{\rm fixed}(p,s).
\]
At $p=s$, exact normalization yields
\[
 R_{\rm fixed}(p,p)=1,
 \qquad \operatorname E[\widehat a_p\mid g]=A.
\]

For a general linear sky and deterministic residual,
\[
 m=\sum_s A_s t_s^{\rm full}+b+n,
\]
the exact fixed-state expectation is
\begin{equation}
 \operatorname E[\widehat a_p\mid g]
 =\sum_s R_{\rm fixed}(p,s)A_s+L_{p,g}b.
 \label{eq:general-sky}
\end{equation}
Unit diagonal response does not make off-diagonal response vanish. Neighboring
or nonlocal templates may contribute, and a mean, offset, gradient, or other
unmodeled deterministic $b$ may bias the one-parameter amplitude. These terms
are response and nuisance leakage, not source attribution or deblending.

\subsection{Local restriction and constrained GLS theorem}
\label{sec:optimality}

For an authorized parent covariance, local restriction precedes inversion:
\begin{equation}
 C_p=E_pC_{\rm parent}E_p^{\mathsf T}.
 \label{eq:local-covariance}
\end{equation}
Let the columns of $U_p$ be an exact orthonormal basis for the declared local
estimable subspace and $P_p=U_pU_p^{\mathsf T}$ its exact projector. Define
\[
 C_{p,E}=U_p^{\mathsf T}C_pU_p,
 \qquad
 W_p=U_pC_{p,E}^{-1}U_p^{\mathsf T},
 \qquad U_p^{\mathsf T}t_p\ne0,
\]
where $C_{p,E}$ is positive definite. This is not a claim that a restricted
global inverse equals the inverse of the restricted covariance.

The competitor class contains exactly the linear estimates $\ell^{\mathsf T}m_p$
with: the identical parent support; the identical $U_p$, constraints, and fixed
state; $\ell=P_p\ell$; and unit response
$\ell^{\mathsf T}t_p=1$ to the identical projected template. The matched GLS
row is
\[
 \ell_* = \frac{W_pt_p}{t_p^{\mathsf T}W_pt_p}.
\]
For every competitor,
\[
 \operatorname{Var}(\ell^{\mathsf T}m_p\mid g)
 -\operatorname{Var}(\ell_*^{\mathsf T}m_p\mid g)
 =(\ell-\ell_*)^{\mathsf T}C_p(\ell-\ell_*)\geq0,
\]
and
\[
 \operatorname{Var}(\widehat a_p\mid g)=d_p^{-1}.
\]
This is the sole minimum-conditional-variance and $d_p^{-1}$ variance route.
It distinguishes covariance zero-variance modes, deliberately excluded or
infinite-variance modes, weighting-null modes, and a projected template with
no identifiable component. A shared numerical null label or an unconstrained
Moore--Penrose operation does not establish the theorem.

\subsection{Fixed-state and full-procedure response}

For frozen state $g_0$,
\[
 R_{\rm fixed}(p,s)=L_{p,g_0}t_s^{\rm full}.
\]
If state was learned from the parent, a full-procedure response exists only
under separately authorized rerun authority. With
\[
 g_\epsilon=\operatorname{Resolve}
   (\operatorname{Learn}(m+\epsilon t_s^{\rm full})),
\]
it is the declared limit or predeclared finite difference
\begin{equation}
 R_{\rm FP}(p,s)=
 \lim_{\epsilon\to0}
 \frac{\widehat a_p(m+\epsilon t_s^{\rm full};g_\epsilon)
       -\widehat a_p(m;g_0)}{\epsilon},
 \label{eq:full-procedure-response}
\end{equation}
or the exact finite-$\epsilon$ analogue with its step, sidedness, and domain
fixed before evaluation. The state-change record is separate. Without this
authority $R_{\rm FP}$ is unavailable.

\subsection{Realized and reference response and covariance}
\label{sec:realized-reference}

Let $L$ be the exact selected scientific operator and $\widetilde L$ the
operator that actually produced a field. Then
\begin{align}
 R_{\rm reference} &= LT,
 & C_{\rm reference} &= LC_{\rm parent}L^{\mathsf T}, \\
 R_{\rm realized} &= \widetilde LT,
 & C_{\rm realized} &= \widetilde L C_{\rm parent}\widetilde L^{\mathsf T}.
\end{align}
An amplitude field generated by $\widetilde L$ shall carry the realized pair,
never the reference pair as though it described the actual field. Either
covariance exists only when matching $C_{\rm parent}$ authority exists. A
diagonal representation does not assert independence, and omitted entries are
unknown.

\subsection{Engineering approximation observables}
\label{sec:approx-metrics}

The following are comparison observables, not owner-selected scientific
thresholds:
\begin{align}
 e_d(p)&=\frac{|\widetilde d_p-d_p|}{d_p}, &
 e_a(p)&=|R_{\rm realized}(p,p)-1|,\\
 e_R&=\|P_{\rm out}(R_{\rm realized}-R_{\rm reference})
                 P_{\rm anc}^{\mathsf T}\|, &
 e_L&=\|P_{\rm out}(\widetilde L-L)P_{\rm in}^{\mathsf T}\|,\\
 e_C&=\|P_{\rm out}(C_{\rm realized}-C_{\rm reference})
                 P_{\rm out}^{\mathsf T}\|.
\end{align}
One preregistered engineering numerical-conformance profile binds norms,
scales, domains, projections, coverage, floating-point environment, exact
subspace projectors, and acceptance rules before evaluation. No package-wide
constant is scientific authority. If an authorized operator intentionally
changes scientific response, support, null space, or estimand, it receives a
separate method/realization identity and publishes that discrepancy.

\subsection{Uncertainty budget and non-combinability}
\label{sec:uncertainty-budget}

\begin{longtable}{p{0.13\linewidth}p{0.29\linewidth}p{0.48\linewidth}}
\toprule
ID & Contribution & Contract treatment \\
\midrule
\endhead
U1 & Parent stochastic covariance & Propagate with the operator that actually
produced the field, for the exact authorized population and conditioning. \\
U2 & Calibration/template scale & Preserve joint CAL/BEAM and parent-template
authority; missing cross-covariance is unavailable, not zero. \\
U3 & Learned-state uncertainty & Base products condition on frozen state.
Marginalization over Learn--Resolve needs separate authority. \\
U4 & Numerical or intentional operator discrepancy & Ordinary numerical error
belongs to the preregistered engineering profile. Intentional scientific
discrepancy changes method/realization identity. \\
U5 & Covariance scope/representation & Declare complete, projected, or
unavailable scope separately from exact representation. \\
U6 & Frozen-NOI empirical uncertainty & A qualified companion with its own
population and finite-sample meaning; it is not automatically parent
covariance or physical noise. \\
U7 & Template mismatch/unmodeled systematics & Outside the base matching-
template covariance and separately reported. \\
\bottomrule
\end{longtable}

No scalar total uncertainty combines these terms unless every term,
cross-term, conditioning relation, unit, and population is authorized.
Absence is unavailable, never zero.
